commands.business_effect: Create commercial opportunity from a verified lead + product snapshot
commands.rollback_strategy: remove opportunity by id while empty downstream; reverse migration only if all sections empty

commands.business_effect: Snapshot product into an offer READY_FOR_OWNER_REVIEW (NOT a send)
commands.rollback_strategy: remove offer by id; revert opp.stage

commands.business_effect: Record owner APPROVE/REJECT/RETURN/PAUSE/CANCEL on an offer
commands.owner_confirmation: single (this IS the owner authority record)
commands.evidence_requirement: offer exists; decision in allowed set
commands.rollback_strategy: decision is an authority fact — correct via new decision event, not deletion

commands.business_effect: Create delivery handoff from a WON deal
commands.rollback_strategy: remove handoff by id while no project exists

commands.business_effect: Create delivery project from a handoff
commands.rollback_strategy: remove project by id while no invoice references it

commands.business_effect: Create DRAFT invoice schedule (classification TARGET; real_issuance DISABLED, bank NONE)
commands.evidence_requirement: deal exists; amount = agreed_price (TARGET until paid)
commands.rollback_strategy: remove draft invoice by id while no payment
commands.note: No real invoice issuance, no bank integration. Internal financial DRAFT only.

commands.business_effect: Record a payment FACT against an invoice (owner-confirmed evidence → invoice PAID)
commands.owner_confirmation: double (financial FACT — requires owner confirmation + evidenceType + evidenceReference)
commands.evidence_requirement: invoice exists; evidenceType AND evidenceReference REQUIRED; classification=FACT, confidence=OWNER_CONFIRMED
commands.rollback_strategy: payment is a financial FACT — never silently deleted; correction is a reversing evidence entry under separate owner approval
commands.note: Separate evidence gate. Financial truth. Highest scrutiny.

C1-A.label: Safe internal commands, no send, no financial FACT

C1-C.label: Transport (email/Telegram/follow-up send)
C1-C.status: FORBIDDEN — not part of any C1 stage
